description: This file defines the 'CallFailedRuntimeException' class, a custom runtime exception used in handling HTTP call failures within the Apache Fineract client, providing detailed error messages and accessors for related call and response objects.

classes.name: CallFailedRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception that wraps Retrofit HTTP call failures, providing contextual information and detailed error messages.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception based on a failed Call and a Throwable, capturing the call details.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception based on a Call and a Response, generating a detailed message.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Static method that constructs a detailed error message from a Call and Response, including HTTP request info, response, message, and error body.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Returns the original Call object associated with the failure.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the Response object associated with the failure, if available.
